documents.title: Record Date For 2Nd Interim Dividend 2026-27 Is 24Th October, 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Date of payment of Dividend
Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited presented its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, reporting a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores. EBITDA for the quarter rose 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores, while Profit After Tax increased by 42.9% YoY to ₹ 65.6 crores. The company is undertaking an ongoing ~₹ 200 crore capex funded via internal accruals to expand ABS capacity from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, with commissioning targeted by 30 September 2026. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue of INR 1,276.0 crores for FY26 along with an EBITDA of INR 255.2 crores and profit after tax of INR 180.2 crores. Management highlighted an ongoing capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA with commissioning targeted by September 2026, supported by a INR 200 crore capex funded through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: Optimal utilization of the expanded ABS capacity is expected by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS will be driven by growth in end-user industries such as consumer durables and automotive.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating ABS consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight plastics for interior trims and battery housings.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: Appliances and automotive sectors continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins.
demand_outlook.quote: Appliances and Automotive continue to dominate global demand for ABS resins due to their high impact resistance and aesthetic versatility.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is shifting toward specialty and colored grades away from commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations reached ₹ 472.2 crores in Q1 FY27, up 53.3% YoY.
margins_costs.quote: Revenue from operations increased by +53.3% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 472.2 crores, from ₹ 307.9 crores in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA grew 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores in Q1 FY27, with EBITDA margin at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA margins stood at 21.8% and FY26 EBITDA margins at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%; for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a debt-free balance sheet.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.
